shortDescription: Create, Delete or Modify volumes on Infinibox

options.name: parent_volume_name
options.description: Specify a volume name. This is the volume parent for creating a snapshot. Required if volume_type is snapshot.

options.name: pool
options.description: Pool that master volume will reside within.  Required for creating a master volume, but not a snapshot.

options.name: restore_volume_from_snapshot
options.description: Specify true to restore a volume (parent_volume_name) from an existing snapshot specified by the name field. State must be set to present and volume_type must be 'snapshot'.

options.name: size
options.description: Volume size in MB, GB or TB units.  Required for creating a master volume, but not a snapshot

options.name: snapshot_lock_expires_at
options.description: This will cause a snapshot to be locked at the specified date-time. Uses python's datetime format YYYY-mm-dd HH:MM:SS.ffffff, e.g. 2020-02-13 16:21:59.699700

options.name: snapshot_lock_only
options.description: This will lock an existing snapshot but will suppress refreshing the snapshot.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates/Modifies master volume or snapshot when present or removes when absent.

options.name: stay_logged_in
options.description: If True, persist API session to disk. Load the session on subsequent module calls. Persisted sessions are only usable for stay_logged_in_minutes.

options.name: stay_logged_in_minutes
options.description: Number of minutes for which a persisted session may be reused. After this time, the session data will be deleted. The time should be shorter than the IBOX session timeout time.

options.name: thin_provision
options.description: Whether the master volume should be thin or thick provisioned.

options.name: user
options.description: Infinibox User username with sufficient priveledges ( see notes ).

options.name: volume_type
options.description: Specifies the volume type, regular volume or snapshot.

options.name: write_protected
options.description: Specifies if the volume should be write protected. Default will be True for snapshots, False for regular volumes.
